title: World biomes map and biome cards
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y6 lesson 13 (World biomes map and biome cards (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 13: Biomes of the world. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: How is a cactus adapted to the desert?

parts.text: Feature: thick stem stores water; spines instead of leaves
Result: loses less water and survives

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: It stores water and reduces water loss

blocks.text: Colour the biomes using the key on the slides; stick each biome card next to one example.

keywords.def: a large area with similar climate, plants and animals
a cold, treeless biome near the Arctic
a hot grassland with scattered trees
a place with less than about 250 mm of rain a year
a feature that helps a living thing survive

questions.q: Which biome is in the UK?
Core: Colour a biome map with a key, then complete a biome card for two biomes: climate, plants, animals, one adaptation.
Extend: Explain why rainforests are found near the equator.
questions.a: Hot and wet all year near the equator

questions.q: Stretch: Which biome is most at risk from people? Why?
A hot grassland with scattered trees is:
questions.a: B) Savanna. Savanna is tropical grassland with a wet and a dry season.

questions.q: A biome is shaped mostly by:
Big question: why do the same plants grow far apart?
questions.a: Places with the same climate have similar biomes, so similar plants grow there
